audit_name: BioTrace Ground Truth Audit: Martin-Hopkins & Bounding Box Fallback

martin_hopkins_table.strata_details: 4 TG strata (<50, <100, <=400, >400) split by non-HDL (<100 vs >=100)
martin_hopkins_table.description: Code implements a condensed 6-branch if/elif heuristic returning discrete divisors {3.5, 4.0, 4.5, 5.0, 5.5, 6.0, 6.5}. It has not been replaced with the full 180-cell empirical lookup matrix published by Martin et al. (JAMA 2013).

bounding_box_fallback.item: Missing / Collapsed [0, 0, 0, 0] Bounding Box Fallback & Sibling Interpolation
bounding_box_fallback.current_behavior: Missing bounding boxes default to [0, 0, 10, 10]. In src/pipeline.py, crops with std < 5.0 or empty dimensions bypass the vision gate and fall back to purely symbolic candidate selection without image enhancement. In src/stage3_vision_gate.py, coordinates are clamped/padded to at least 1px without inferring geometry from neighboring cells.
bounding_box_fallback.description: No sibling bounding box interpolation, vertical row height extrapolation, or table column alignment logic exists in the codebase. When a bounding box is absent or [0, 0, 0, 0], visual crop restoration is skipped entirely.
